PIAST_AT.local_evidence: 1900 exact CSV/MIDI matches; already repeatedly inspected
PIAST_AT.limits: Tagging instructions excluded subtle mood changes; labels describe excerpts, not their trajectories.

VGMIDI.unit: piano game-music arrangement with approximately 30 time-varying ratings
VGMIDI.local_evidence: 200 labeled pieces, 141/200 accepted by current temporal pipeline
VGMIDI.limits: Valence and arousal are not names such as Mysterious or Epic; the expanded ten-piece test was previously inspected.

ISOVAT.unit: 90 four-bar MIDI clips in ten triplets per affective dimension
ISOVAT.local_evidence: Ten tension triplets compared against published aggregate human orders
ISOVAT.limits: Between-clip ranks, not within-clip tension trajectories; votes are not verified in AnaMu as per-listener training records.

PERCEPIANO.local_evidence: 1072 usable human performances from four parent works in current AnaMu subset
PERCEPIANO.limits: Dark/imaginative/dramatic performance attributes are not the identically named PIAST clip mood tags; only four independent parent works.

CP_WTC.unit: first eight bars of 48 Bach pieces, each by six pianists
CP_WTC.local_evidence: 288 performances, 7652 listener ratings; six grouped folds
CP_WTC.limits: Valence/arousal of interpretations, not a time series of named emotions; MIDI may contain transcription timing/dynamics errors.

EMOPIA.local_evidence: Public release has one quadrant label per clip, not four independent votes
EMOPIA.limits: Four annotators participated in creation, but each song was primarily assigned to one; no PIAST-style per-item vote fractions.

XMIDI.unit: 108023 MIDI files with whole-piece emotion and genre classes
XMIDI.local_evidence: Metadata/name-based classes; individual annotator votes and repeated-work identities not verified locally
XMIDI.limits: No time-coded emotion labels; neither genre nor predicted labels should be substituted for human temporal truth.

DCML_DLC.unit: score-time event with analyst-coded cadence in 1283 annotated compositions across DLC; three subcorpora used in first pilot
DCML_DLC.local_evidence: Chopin Mazurkas, Mozart Piano Sonatas and Bach English/French Suites notes and harmonies TSV checked out at pinned upstream SHAs; movement siblings grouped by K or BWV identifier
DCML_DLC.limits: Analyst-annotated cadences are musicological structural judgments, NOT human emotions, tension curves, or independent ratings; the benchmark uses no expert key or chord as features. Scores are symbolic not performance MIDI. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

partitura_tension.limit: Tonal proxies, not a measured emotion or original instrument timbre.

music21_harmony.limit: An inferred chord/function is not an annotated ground truth or human feeling.

melody_features.limit: Published feature extraction is not validated human continuation prediction.

jsymbolic.limit: Global/windowed MIDI descriptors, not original acoustic spectrum, envelope or timbre.

idyom_original.limit: Import/launcher exist, but no original Lisp execution is reported in AnaMu.

farbood_proxy.limit: Not Farbood's fitted original equations or human-continuous calibration.

tonal_motion_proxy.limit: Not MIDIBERT/MoFi; on PIAST the window order did not beat its permutation.

relative_expression_model.limit: Not an implementation of authors' complete Delta-VA/RnC model.

cadential_note_context_proxy.limit: AnaMu exploratory note-only classifier, not DCML's analytic annotations, an original published cadence detector, or affect prediction.
